image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim variety) lying on a textured grey blanket. The dog has a rich chestnut and white coat, large dark eyes, and long feathered ears. It is resting its chin on its paws, looking directly at the camera. The background consists of vertical wooden slats.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat exhibits the classic Blenheim pattern: a white base with distinct chestnut/red markings on the ears and around the eyes, plus a white blaze on the forehead.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture appears soft and slightly wavy/silky rather than coarse. Feathering is clearly visible on the ears and chest area.
